title: RashidaAi Bootcamp Landing Page (waitlist, countdown, syllabus, FAQ, scripted chatbot)

requirements.summary: Create a modern, fully responsive single-page landing page using a vibrant turquoise + hot pink + purple palette with prominent waitlist CTAs.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page renders correctly on mobile, tablet, and desktop without horizontal scrolling.
Typography, buttons, and section styling consistently reflect a turquoise/hot pink/purple palette (no blue/purple default theme).
Page includes a prominent “Join the waitlist” CTA near the top and again near the bottom.
All user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create the single-page landing layout with clear sections (hero, countdown, syllabus, preview, FAQ, waitlist, footer) and two prominent “Join the waitlist” CTAs (hero + near bottom), using in-page anchors for navigation.

Add Tailwind base/components/utilities and define global theme tokens/CSS variables to enforce the turquoise/hot pink/purple palette consistently across typography, backgrounds, buttons, and focus rings.
Extend theme (as needed) with brand color utilities and/or gradients to support the required turquoise/hot pink/purple styling without default-blue emphasis.
Ensure document metadata remains English-friendly and wire favicon reference (also used in REQ-9) without adding extra pages.

requirements.summary: Add a waitlist signup form (name + email) with validation, clear success/failure messaging, and backend call integration with graceful duplicate handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend form includes at least: full name and email (and may include optional fields like goals/experience).
Form validates required fields and shows clear success/failure messages.
On submit, the app calls a backend method to store the waitlist entry.
Duplicate submissions for the same email are handled gracefully (either prevented or updated) with a user-friendly message.

file_operations.description: Implement a waitlist form UI with required fields (full name, email), optional fields (e.g., goals/experience), client-side validation, and success/failure messaging; on submit call the backend capability addToWaitlist(name, email) and display a friendly duplicate-submission message when applicable.

Create a small frontend backend-client helper that exposes typed calls matching frontend/src/backend.d.ts (including addToWaitlist) so the waitlist form can call the backend capability without embedding backend details in UI components.
Wire the WaitlistForm into the landing page at a stable in-page anchor (e.g., #waitlist) and connect hero/bottom CTAs to scroll/focus the waitlist form for quick access.

requirements.summary: Add a countdown timer to Feb 14, 2026 with days/hours/minutes/seconds and a graceful event-started state.
acceptanceCriteria: Countdown targets Feb 14, 2026 and updates at least once per second.
UI displays a clear label (e.g., “Cohort starts in”) and numeric time units.
When the date/time has passed, UI switches to a sensible state (e.g., “Enrollment closed / Cohort started” or “Join the next waitlist”).

file_operations.description: Build a countdown component that ticks at least once per second toward Feb 14, 2026, renders days/hours/minutes/seconds, and switches to a clear post-date state (prompting waitlist CTA).
Add a reusable countdown hook to compute remaining time and the event-started state, with interval cleanup to avoid memory leaks.
Place the countdown in a dedicated section near the top of the landing page with a clear label and brand-styled time-unit display.

requirements.summary: Create a mobile-friendly Syllabus section showing a clear 4-week curriculum with scannable headings and bullet points, reachable via scrolling/nav.
acceptanceCriteria: Syllabus is shown as a 4-week structure with headings for Week 1–Week 4.
Content is readable on mobile (no dense multi-column layouts that break).
Syllabus section is reachable via page scrolling and/or an in-page navigation link.

file_operations.description: Create a syllabus section that presents Week 1–Week 4 with scannable headings and bullet points, optimized for mobile readability (stacked layout, comfortable spacing).
Wire the SyllabusSection into the landing page and add an in-page navigation link (e.g., in header/hero) so users can jump directly to the syllabus section.

requirements.summary: Add an interactive, keyboard-accessible course preview (tabs/cards per week) that reveals sample lesson details without external services.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can interact (click/tap) to switch between preview items (e.g., weeks/modules) and see details update without page reload.
Preview is keyboard accessible (tab focus + enter/space) and works on mobile touch.
Preview content is visually distinct from the main syllabus (e.g., “Sample lesson preview” panel).

file_operations.description: Implement a local interactive preview using buttons (tab-like) or selectable cards for Week 1–Week 4 that updates a distinct “Sample lesson preview” panel; ensure keyboard interaction (Enter/Space) and visible focus styles.
Add the InteractivePreview section adjacent to (but visually distinct from) the main syllabus section so users can explore sample lessons without leaving the page.

requirements.summary: Add an accessible FAQ accordion with multiple Q&A items aligned to the bootcamp waitlist context.
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ items expand/collapse individually with smooth, accessible behavior.
Accordion supports keyboard navigation and has clear open/closed indicators.
FAQ content is in English and aligned with a bootcamp waitlist context (date, length, who it’s for, etc.).

file_operations.description: Create an FAQ accordion (e.g., using semantic details/summary or equivalent accessible pattern) with multiple bootcamp-relevant questions/answers, clear indicators, and keyboard-friendly expand/collapse behavior.
Wire the FaqAccordion into the landing page with an in-page anchor (e.g., #faq) and consistent brand styling.

requirements.summary: Include an open/close chatbot widget with a local scripted intent flow (no external AI calls) that can direct users to the waitlist form.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat widget can be opened/closed and does not obstruct key content on mobile.
Chatbot provides useful responses for a small set of predefined intents (e.g., dates, duration, pricing/unknown, prerequisites, how to join waitlist).
Chatbot includes a clear action to “Join the waitlist” (scrolls to or opens the form).
No third-party AI/LLM service integration is required for the chatbot to function.

file_operations.description: Implement a floating chatbot widget with open/close behavior, a simple local scripted intent matcher (dates, duration, prerequisites, pricing/unknown, join waitlist), and a “Join the waitlist” action that scrolls to/focuses the waitlist form.
Define the chatbot’s predefined intents, example utterances/keywords, and response copy (English) for a deterministic local flow without any external LLM/API calls.
Mount the ChatbotWidget globally on the landing page and pass it a handler to scroll to the waitlist anchor; ensure its placement avoids obstructing key content on mobile.

requirements.summary: Add provided generated brand visuals as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in hero/header and favicon.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are committed under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend (not served through the backend).
At least one generated visual is used in the hero area (background/illustration) and one small logo/icon is used in the header and/or favicon.
Images match the turquoise/hot pink/purple aesthetic and look clean/modern.

file_operations.description: Add the generated hero background image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/rashidaai-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png and keep it as a static public asset referenced by the frontend.
Add the generated logo mark at frontend/public/assets/generated/rashidaai-logo.dim_512x512.png for use in the header/branding area as a static public asset referenced by the frontend.
Add the generated chatbot icon at frontend/public/assets/generated/rashidaai-chat-icon.dim_256x256.png for use as the chat widget button graphic as a static public asset referenced by the frontend.
Add the generated favicon image at frontend/public/assets/generated/rashidaai-favicon.dim_64x64.png for wiring into frontend/index.html.
Wire the favicon to frontend/public/assets/generated/rashidaai-favicon.dim_64x64.png via appropriate head markup so the browser displays the brand icon.

Use frontend/public/assets/generated/rashidaai-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png in the hero/branding area and display frontend/public/assets/generated/rashidaai-logo.dim_512x512.png in the header/hero branding; ensure visuals fit the turquoise/hot pink/purple aesthetic.
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/rashidaai-chat-icon.dim_256x256.png as the visible icon/button for the chatbot widget while maintaining good mobile spacing and tap targets.
